title: EU AI Act
summary: The EU's risk-based regulation of AI systems, phased in through 2027.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 entered into force in August 2024. It bans certain practices, imposes transparency and documentation duties on general-purpose models from August 2025, and phases in high-risk obligations for products and regulated uses through 2026 and 2027. Compliance is a documentation burden that favours larger vendors with legal capacity, while giving buyers a common vocabulary for procurement.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Mass production
Estimated window 2024–2027
Confidence label Confirmed
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

The Act is becoming a de facto export standard: vendors document to EU rules because their customers sell there.

What Would Change The View

  • Guidance on general-purpose model obligations.
  • Enforcement actions and fines.
  • Interaction with national security exemptions.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
